answer: Anchor each agent key to a web domain its operator controls. The key must be published at /.well-known/agent.json on that domain, the ledger counts one identity per registrable domain and re-fetches the file every epoch, so a lapsed domain drops its key. A farm wanting 1,000 heads must buy and renew 1,000 domains, and weighting votes by domain age stops fresh $1 TLDs from becoming an oasis. No ivory-tower registry is needed: DNS is already a paid, public, auditable namespace.
